definitions.gloss: discounted price; reduced price; sale price
definitions.explanation: A price that has been lowered from the original or standard amount. Used in shopping, business, and everyday commerce.

examples.japanese: {割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can buy it at a discounted price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}される→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The discounted price applies to members.

examples.japanese: ⟦{期間|きかん}{限定|げんてい}→期間限定：09744_kikangentei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぜひ⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧。
examples.english: We are selling at a limited-time discounted price, so please take advantage of this opportunity.

notes:
A straightforward compound of ⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧ (discount) and ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ (price). Widely used in advertising, store signage, and online shopping. While ⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧ alone can modify nouns, the full compound {割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく} is preferred when the focus is specifically on the numerical price.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at a discounted price
- {割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}される→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧: a discount is applied
- ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧{割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}: special discounted price
- ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧{割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}: student discount price

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{定価|ていか}→定価：04066_teika⟧: list price; retail price — the original price before any discount
- ⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧: half price — a specific type of discount
- ⟦{特価|とっか}→特価：18798_tokka⟧: special price; bargain price — implies a particularly good deal
